$comment:
Generated from moodbow-web src/lib/import (planImport, decodeImportFile, importEntryId) by src/lib/import/importCases.test.ts; the web checks it on every CI run. Inputs: csv (text), base64 (file bytes, through decodeImportFile first), or generate (days: one 'date,mood' row a day going back from today; entries: 'date,mood,note' rows, three a day, 'Note '; results summarized, ids = first and last). Entry id: UUIDv5(namespace, UTF-8 of `${userId}|${date}|${time ?? ''}|${body}` + (dup ? `|#${dup}` : '')). Daylio notes: DOMParser text/html,
→ \n, p/div/li get \n appended, textContent, 3+ newlines → 2, trim. Caps: 2000 days, 5000 entries (the newest), 10485760 bytes, a note over 20000 UTF-16 units skipped.

cases.name: (a) everything already there: nothing kept
(b) a fresh account: every copy kept
(c) 1 copy there, 2 in the file: exactly the second (dup 1)
(d) more already there than in the file: none of it, never negative
(e) the same text on another day is not a copy
